applications.digital_copy: Field notebooks built around observations that are easy to record and hand over.
applications.print_copy: 01  Mark the station.  02  Note conditions.  03  Index the observation.

context: Volunteer survey leads need to record and find entries in poor light. Working category cues are notebook tabs, field coordinates and contour maps. Market cues are hypotheses for a fictional exercise; no clearance search was performed.

hypotheses.composition: Two masses bend around a rising open corridor; use a restrained low-contrast secondary pine.
hypotheses.metaphor: An unbroken survey route reads as a pale channel between two contour forms.
hypotheses.reason: Conveys navigation without using a literal pin or leaf. Test negative-space separation.
hypotheses.title: Transect

hypotheses.composition: Pair a tall folded stroke with a tapered counterstroke and a real open joint.
hypotheses.metaphor: Two folded paper edges meet at the angle of a penciled check.
hypotheses.reason: A useful counterpoint to the organic direction. Readability is more immediate, distinctiveness may be weaker.
hypotheses.title: Folded V

hypotheses.composition: Two open corner shapes offset along a diagonal with a clear central void.
hypotheses.metaphor: Two offset notebook brackets frame the observation that matters.
hypotheses.reason: Makes the recording frame visible and tests whether it reads beyond a generic focus icon.
hypotheses.title: Sample Window

hypotheses.composition: Draw the word as a low silhouette, adding an index spur to the K.
hypotheses.metaphor: A small right-facing spur behaves like a handwritten index tick.
hypotheses.reason: Tests whether name recognition can carry the identity. Compact symbol remains an open issue.
hypotheses.title: Index Type

hypotheses.composition: Two opposing tickets connected by a visible seam.
hypotheses.metaphor: Two tags overlap like records passed between volunteers.
hypotheses.reason: The overlap tends to read as a collaboration or messaging product.
hypotheses.title: Handoff Pair

hypotheses.composition: Three nodes in offset rows with changing scale.
hypotheses.metaphor: Three dots mark repeated stops along a survey line.
hypotheses.reason: At 16 pixels the emphasis hierarchy could collapse into a generic menu or network.
hypotheses.title: Station Dots

hypotheses.composition: Sweep one soft wave under a hand-drawn block.
hypotheses.metaphor: Ink remains legible across a wet page.
hypotheses.reason: Overweights aquatic habitats and risks reading as a water brand.
hypotheses.title: Waterline

hypotheses.composition: Compact enclosed rectangle with a tab at its crown.
hypotheses.metaphor: A tabbed field label carries date and site.
hypotheses.reason: An enclosure and metadata would crowd the cover stamp.
hypotheses.title: Tab Seal

hypotheses.composition: One fast diagonal and short counterstroke.
hypotheses.metaphor: A pencil mark confirms that a stop is recorded.
hypotheses.reason: A check is crowded territory and can imply certification.
hypotheses.title: Margin Tick

hypotheses.composition: Stack translucent page silhouettes at close intervals.
hypotheses.metaphor: Each observation leaves a second copy for handover.
hypotheses.reason: Translucency is incompatible with the one-ink stamp and obscures the geometry.
hypotheses.title: Echo Page

mode_reason: The primary job is a one-ink cover stamp with clean negative space. Native curves are directly editable.

references.observation: One-ink stamp and mobile catalog are the main constraints.
